# Maksym Shykov

> Engineering Manager who still ships. 15 years in software, from QA engineer
> to Engineering Manager at MacPaw (Setapp) and Headway.

Maksym Shykov is an Engineering Manager based in Lisbon, open to new roles
(Lisbon or remote). He has led cross-functional teams since 2022, and managed
people since 2021. He still writes code and builds side products for the people
an engineering manager works with. The site contains his experience, writing on
engineering management, and links to those products.

## Core Pages

- Home: https://shykov.dev/
- Experience: https://shykov.dev/experience
- Writing: https://shykov.dev/blog
- The Engineer Changelog: https://shykov.dev/blog/the-engineer-changelog
- From Software Engineer to Product Engineer: https://shykov.dev/blog/software-engineer-to-product-engineer
- Professional Development Plan for Engineers (template and real examples): https://shykov.dev/blog/professional-development-plan-for-engineers

## Projects

- Aploma (for managers, private preview): https://aploma.dev/ — turns weekly 1:1 notes into the evidence behind reviews, development plans and salary decisions
- CoffeeSlack (for teams): https://www.coffeeslack.com/ — random coffee for Slack that reports whether people actually met
- local-review (for engineers, open source): https://local-review.shykov.dev/ — privacy-first multi-LLM code review in the terminal
- ATS Resume Toolkit (for candidates, open source): https://cv.shykov.dev/ — resume checker and builder that runs entirely in the browser
- Also: Alotno https://alotno.app/, Zero to Moat https://moat.shykov.dev/
